name: team-expert
title: Team Expert Grid
description: A light team showcase: a four-across row of portrait cards with names and roles that fill with orange on hover, and four activity cards beneath.
use: A team or expert lineup needs small profile cards plus a row of related activities.
avoid: Four people are hardcoded, and hover-only colour changes are lost on touch.
a11y: READ MORE buttons have no focus styling and no click handler, and hover is the only card feedback. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A warm off-white section under a centred heading and grey paragraph. Four portrait cards in pale peach hold a square photo, a bold name, a small role line and a READ MORE link; below sit four white cards with round orange icon tiles.
behaves: Hovering a portrait card floods it solid orange, turns its text white and nudges the READ MORE arrow sideways. The activity icons swell slightly on hover too.
customise: Names, roles, photos and activity titles come from the EXPERT_TEAM array and inline props; hover colours are classes.
weight: light: Eight static cards and CSS hover transitions, with a short reveal on scroll.
demo: Experts Eskild Ebbesen, Henrik Duer, Rikke Hørlykke and Stig Severinsen, with activities Workout and Mindfulness.
issues: READ MORE buttons have no click handler, so they do nothing.
Photos and names are hardcoded, and colour feedback appears on hover only.
polishWhy: Warm card rhythm and a bold hover fill; the dead READ MORE buttons are the flaw.
